# Workflows

Durable background jobs: a Jobs service on Cloudflare Workflows, with an example workflow and server functions.

Id `extras/workflows`. It is one of the Extras: a project can have any number of them. Template: [`templates/extras/workflows/`](../../templates/extras/workflows/).

## What it is for

Durable background jobs on Cloudflare Workflows. Start a job and read its status through the `Jobs` service; Cloudflare runs the workflow's steps and keeps their results, so a job survives restarts. `apps/web/src/workflows/Example.ts` is a workflow to copy.

## Add it

When you create the project:

```sh
npm create efforge my-app -- --extras=workflows
```

Add it to an existing project:

```sh
npx create-efforge add extras/workflows
```

## Needs

- The Cloudflare runtime, which every project has today.

## Conflicts with

Nothing.

## Service and layer

Your code asks for `Jobs`, declared in `packages/core/src/jobs.ts`. Its members:

- `start(job, payload)`. Fails with `JobError`.
- `status(job, id)`. Fails with `JobError`.

`JobsLive` implements it, and `efforge add` puts it in `AppLayer` in `apps/web/src/server/layers.ts`.

- To test code that uses `Jobs`, give it a test layer: `Layer.succeed(Jobs, Jobs.of({ ... }))`. See [Swap a layer to test](../testing.md).
- To change the provider, write another layer for `Jobs` and use it in `layers.ts` in place of `JobsLive`.

## Files it writes

`efforge add` writes these files.

- `packages/core/src/jobs.ts`
- `apps/web/src/workflows/Example.ts`
- `apps/web/src/server/jobs.ts`
- `apps/web/src/server/example-job.ts`

## Files it edits

`efforge add` makes these edits with AST transforms (changes to the parsed code, not to its text), so it changes only what is listed and leaves the rest of each file alone.

### `packages/core/src/index.ts`

- Re-exports everything from `./jobs`.

### `apps/web/src/server.ts`

- Exports `Example` from `./workflows/Example`.

### `apps/web/src/server/layers.ts`

- Adds `JobsLive` to `AppLayer`, imported from `./jobs`.

### `wrangler.jsonc`

- Adds a `workflows` entry: `{"name":"example","binding":"EXAMPLE_WORKFLOW","class_name":"Example"}`. Only with `infra=none`.

### `infra/alchemy.run.ts`

- Declares `exampleWorkflow` and binds it to the Worker as `EXAMPLE_WORKFLOW`. Only with `infra=alchemy`.

### `apps/web/src/server/example-job.ts`

- Runs `requireSession` before every server function in the file. Only with `auth=better-auth` or `auth=better-auth-orgs`.

### `efforge.jsonc`

- Records the add-on in the stack and the hashes of the files it wrote.
